title: Automorphisms of Twisted Chevalley Groups of type ${}^2 A_3$ and ${}^2 A_4$ over Local Rings
summary: We give a complete classification of the automorphisms of twisted Chevalley groups of types ${}^2A_3$ and ${}^2A_4$, and of their elementary subgroups, over commutative local rings $R$ containing $1/2$ and equipped with a non-trivial involution $θ$. The classification covers all isogeny types and, together with our higher-rank result~\cite{EB&DM1}, completes the description for type ${}^2A_{\ell}$ with $\ell\geq3$.
